concept: DynamoDB Global Tables: multi-Region active-active writes
tests: Choosing a data store with local writes in multiple Regions that keeps working independently when another Region is down.
expected: DynamoDB global tables — multi-leader replication, each Region accepts local writes, conflicts resolved last-writer-wins. Triggers: "low-latency writes in multiple Regions", "a Region keeps working if another is unavailable", "active-active".
why_not: RDS Multi-AZ is single-Region, no local writes elsewhere; Aurora cross-Region read replicas accept writes only in the primary Region; S3 CRR of a JSON file is not a concurrent multi-writer database.
